class.name: CgamePathTracer
class.brief_description: Multithreaded CPU path tracer for light baking and offline image rendering.

method.name: accumulate
method.description: Adds [param spp] samples per pixel to the progressive image started by [method begin_progressive]. The camera looks down its local -Z axis and [param fov_deg] is the vertical field of view in degrees. [param light] is a dictionary as returned by [method make_light]; missing keys use defaults (warm sun, blue-grey sky, 0.7 grey albedo, 3 bounces). Each call uses fresh random streams, so repeated calls refine the estimate.

method.name: bake_ambient_occlusion
method.description: Returns ambient visibility per vertex: [code]1.0[/code] is fully open and [code]0.0[/code] is fully enclosed within [param max_dist]. [param normals] must have one entry per vertex. Uses [param samples] cosine-distributed rays per vertex.

method.name: bake_vertex_lighting
method.description: Returns baked linear lighting per vertex (alpha is [code]1.0[/code]). [param vertices] and [param normals] are per vertex, three per triangle; vertex [code]i[/code] takes the albedo of triangle [code]i / 3[/code] from [param albedo_per_tri] (0.7 grey where the array is too short). [param samples] is the number of indirect paths per vertex and [param bounces] the maximum number of surface interactions per path; [code]0[/code] gives direct sun plus sky visibility only.

method.name: begin_progressive
method.description: Starts a new progressive image of the given [param size] and clears any previous accumulation. [param seed] selects the random streams.

method.name: get_passes
method.description: Returns the number of [method accumulate] calls since [method begin_progressive].

method.name: get_pixel
method.description: Returns the mean linear color of the pixel at ([param x], [param y]) as (r, g, b), or zero if nothing was accumulated yet.

method.name: get_progressive_size
method.description: Returns the size passed to [method begin_progressive].

method.name: get_samples
method.description: Returns the number of samples per pixel accumulated so far.

method.name: make_light
method.description: Builds the light and material dictionary accepted by [method accumulate] and [method render_image], with the keys [code]sun_dir[/code], [code]sun_color[/code], [code]sky_color[/code], [code]albedo[/code] and [code]bounces[/code].

method.name: render_image
method.description: Renders a one-shot image with [param spp] samples per pixel and returns it as an [constant Image.FORMAT_RGB8] image (clamped and gamma 2.2 encoded). The same arguments and seed always produce the same image.

method.name: to_image
method.description: Returns the current progressive estimate as an [constant Image.FORMAT_RGB8] image, clamped and gamma 2.2 encoded.

method.name: to_linear_image
method.description: Returns the current progressive estimate as a linear [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBF] image, preserving HDR radiance above [code]1.0[/code]. Returns black pixels before the first accumulation.
